mapper.select: SELECT pap.id, pap.assessment_name, p.name as patient_name, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) as age, p.medical_record_no as medical_record_number, p.disease_type, p.enrollment_institution, pap.execution_institution, pap.status, pap.prescribing_doctor, pap.created_time, pap.updated_time FROM patient_assessment_plan pap LEFT JOIN patient p ON pap.patient_id = p.id WHERE pap.id = #{id}
